mentions.name: Cafegrinds
mentions.description: A hyperlocal social app that invites people to work together in person, letting remote workers meet publicly in work settings and connect professionally or personally over repeated sessions, with groups capped at three people for more intimate conversations. Currently free and available only in Bangalore.
mentions.problem: Networking is difficult for freelancers, remote workers, and introverts: events and meetups are paid or too infrequent to build coworker-like camaraderie, and in coworking spaces people rarely initiate conversations or ever see the same person again.
mentions.audience: Remote workers and freelancers looking for in-person work companionship and networking in Bangalore.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on cafegrinds.com - a simple hyperlocal social app to invite people to work together.
mentions.author: achie27
